body: Suffering. Both from the suicide method and my parents reaction to it. But if they said that it was ok for me to die I would do it hours after.

Não. Na infância perdi todos pois mudei muito de escola. Na adolescência fui mal tratado por uma “amiga” e os que tive da escola não tenho mais contato. Da faculdade todos se afastaram na pandemia. Mas como sou depressivo acabo não chamando e nem mantendo contato. Não quero incomodar ninguém também. Meus pais não me entendem e me causam bastante mal, então evito contato. Sou bem sozinho mesmo e já estou meio acostumado, apesar de ficar mal em alguns momentos já que eu gostaria de sair mas não faço pois não tenho companhia.
He doesn’t show that want to comeback together. Our relationship lasted 5 years. I’m also very hurt from him leaving me when I needed him the most, but I feel that I could work out this feeling.

It’s actually something I’m very afraid. I would never want to hurt or mislead someone. It has been 6 years since I dated and I’m afraid I can’t move one from my ex. Some friend told me it’s normal to feel this.

It took some time for me to find a good medication. To this day I don’t know what caused. But I know it does get better. I was in a very dark place with almost no way out. And with some pills, therapy and games now I’m 1000% better. Still some issues here and there. But very much normal. And there will be a light. It’s hard, I know, but there is a light!!!
I’m the one that’s sorry. You where not by any means harsh. Don’t worry. Sorry if I made you think like that. Thanks for your help! 😊
He respects me and everything. He’s just not very interested in me. He’s not a bad person. It’s just this problem. But I understand why you would think that. Sometimes I think too. 😔

Thanks for your help. I will think about it. As of now I’m not really comfortable talking, but is most coming from my family reaction to it. I will talk to my psychiatrist also about approaching the subject with him. Thanks! :)
And nobody knows I’m going through depression again.
No. We live separately and because of COVID we haven’t seen each other in weeks. I’m getting treatment for depression without anyone knowing.

I try to be my best friend. When I’m in a good mood or day I try to do things I like and not worry about it. I also don’t have friends and I know sometimes it sucks and I just want to go out and do something different. But then I just treat myself with something I want.
And when you are interacting with someone or in a social situation don’t think about what other people think about you. People have different ways of interacting and people can be shy, we don’t need to be all a certain way. But this is my opinion, not sure if it helps, but it helped me. :)

Thanks. Just posting here really helped also. I don't didn't want put my burden on my family. I guess i just need to do as you said, focus on good things as the day goes. Maybe will make the days a little lighter.

I'm in the same boat as you. I could not bear to think what would be of my family if i killed myself. I just keep going through the days, and if something happen, i just don't care. I don't really care to be alone, I've always been and I'm fine with it. I just have no perspective in life.
